test: [INV-SCH-09] falsifier: three days offline do not move the chip or the fraction
what: Three days offline decay around 180 items below the mastery threshold and the learner completes a lesson. Score computed from live retrievability walks backwards, which takes a number away from somebody for not opening an app. Score is learned, not remembered (EC-HUB-07); strength bars are the surface that renders retrievability, and they say Ready to review.
measured: 2026-09-11. Sixty mastered items, every row then forced to stability 1 and retrievability 0.1: points, fractionToNext and masteredCount are all unchanged. The score floor additionally survives a mastery threshold raised in a later release.
